summary: Sources give 2 different answers to “On what date did OpenAI appoint Emmett Shear as interim CEO?”: 2023-11-19 (4 sources), 2023-11-20 (4 sources). No primary source found.
Sources give 2 different answers to “On what date was Mira Murati named interim CEO of OpenAI?”: 2023-11-17 (1 source), 2023-11-18 (1 source). No primary source found.
Sources give 2 different answers to “On what date did OpenAI announce Greg Brockman had resigned as president?”: 2023-11-17 (1 source), 2023-11-18 (3 sources). No primary source found.
Sources give 2 different answers to “On what date did Sam Altman and Greg Brockman announce they were joining Microsoft?”: 2023-11-19 (1 source), 2023-11-20 (3 sources). No primary source found.

text: Sources agree that the OpenAI board fired Sam Altman as CEO on 2023-11-17 and that the board had 6 members. Sources disagree on when Emmett Shear was appointed interim CEO (2023-11-19 vs 2023-11-20), when Mira Murati was named interim CEO (2023-11-17 vs 2023-11-18), when Greg Brockman's resignation as president was announced (2023-11-17 vs 2023-11-18), and when Altman and Brockman announced they were joining Microsoft (2023-11-19 vs 2023-11-20). No primary source in this run settles the disputed points.
